description: Liste over gyldige ekomnettautorisasjoner is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nkom.no. Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet (Nkom) innvilger autorisasjon til virksomhet som skal installere og vedlikeholde elektroniske kommunikasjonsnett. Lista inneholder informasjon om autorisasjonskategori (ENA/ekomnett-, TIA/teleinstallatør-, RIA/radioinstallatør og KIA/kabel-TV-installatørautorisasjon), autorisasjonsnummer, firmanavn, organisasjonsnummer, postadresse, postnummer, poststed og kvalifisert person. Coverage: NO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2020-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
